What's in the Box?
SOUND-BASED HORROR · UNREAL ENGINE 5

A puzzle-driven horror game where the player must shake boxes, identify their contents from sound, and place them in the correct order while staying aware of approaching enemies. Enemies can pass through the area and spot the player, but their breathing gives an audio warning. Turning on the lights is the player's way to make them move on, turning a simple sorting task into a tense puzzle.

Shake each box to identify its contents through sound
Use the information from each box to place the boxes in the correct order
Enemies pass through the environment and can spot the player
Breathing audio warns the player when an enemy is nearby
Turn on lights to make enemies move on and create safe opportunities to solve the puzzle
Multiple difficulty levels change the pressure placed on the player

Coin collection loop that rewards risky and efficient movement

High-score focused gameplay built around survival and efficient collection
